usage: answerback [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--version]
                  {maintenance,bus,actors,route,workers,capacity,rebalance,fleet,events,debug,pressure,completion,mcp,doctor,clients,skill,providers,notify,notification-status,desktop-sessions,send-desktop,read-desktop,crew-configure,crew-create,read-crew,hc-configure,read-hc,send-herdr,read-herdr,kiro-register,kiro-sessions,rex-configure,read-rex,rex-enroll,rex-receive,rex-ack,rex-complete,rex-retire,peers,self-test,live-test,workspace,config,find,send,tasks,permissions,permission-answer,cancel,mcp-config,serve,start,restart,stop,status,logs,reset,configure,pair,task,complete,abandon,install,uninstall,herdr-app} ...

Local coordination for coding agents

positional arguments:
  {maintenance,bus,actors,route,workers,capacity,rebalance,fleet,events,debug,pressure,completion,mcp,doctor,clients,skill,providers,notify,notification-status,desktop-sessions,send-desktop,read-desktop,crew-configure,crew-create,read-crew,hc-configure,read-hc,send-herdr,read-herdr,kiro-register,kiro-sessions,rex-configure,read-rex,rex-enroll,rex-receive,rex-ack,rex-complete,rex-retire,peers,self-test,live-test,workspace,config,find,send,tasks,permissions,permission-answer,cancel,mcp-config,serve,start,restart,stop,status,logs,reset,configure,pair,task,complete,abandon,install,uninstall,herdr-app}
    maintenance         Preview or explicitly maintain local SQLite history
    bus                 Durable delivery and live monitoring
    actors              Administer explicitly enrolled project actors
    route               Classify a brief, pick or create a worker, and submit
                        it
    workers             Create, list and remove managed workers
    capacity            Measure machine capacity and suggest placement
    rebalance           Preview at most one move of a worker to another
                        machine; changes nothing
    fleet               Publish the fleet document for the Herdr App
    events              Follow the observe-only AG-UI 1.0 event stream
    debug               Temporarily trace a local task or peer
    pressure            Show provider rate pressure, or clear one account's
                        hold
    completion          Print tab-completion setup for your shell
    mcp                 Run the local STDIO MCP server
    doctor              Check configured provider connections
    clients             Register MCP connections in coding clients
    skill               Install the collaboration skill and the setup skill
    providers           Opt in to specific bridge providers
    notify              Queue an addressed client-inbox notification
    notification-status
                        Read a passive notice's client acknowledgement
    desktop-sessions    Browse indexed Desktop/IDE chats
    send-desktop        Submit work to desktop
    crew-configure      Enable authenticated local Kirocrew access
    crew-create         Create a dedicated Kirocrew project chat
    read-crew           Read bounded Kirocrew chat history
    hc-configure        Enable Herdr App/core discovery and delivery
    read-hc             Read an explicit core terminal
    send-herdr          Submit work to herdr
    kiro-register       Alias for workspace add; Crew is configured separately
    kiro-sessions       Search saved Kiro session metadata
    rex-configure       Probe and configure a local Rex endpoint
    read-rex            Read an explicit Rex terminal snapshot
    rex-enroll          Enroll an explicit cooperative conversation
    rex-receive         Fetch queued messages before acknowledging
    rex-ack             Acknowledge one exact received task
    rex-complete        Record a correlated Rex result
    rex-retire          Retire enrollment before a new conversation
    peers               List peers across configured providers
    self-test           Verify bidirectional collaboration
    live-test           Legacy Herdr TUI test; Herdr App uses the attended hc
                        checklist in docs/LIVE-TEST.md
    workspace           Manage named native CLI project workspaces
    config              Find or archive old bridge configurations
    find                Find peers by name or project keywords
    send                Submit to a unique peer name or project match
    tasks               Find recent task receipts by peer keywords
    mcp-config          Print a STDIO MCP entry
    serve               Run the shared bridge in the foreground
    start               Start the bridge service
    restart             Restart the bridge service
    stop                Stop only the bridge service
    status              Service state and last provider observations
    logs                Read body-free operational logs
    reset               Clear connection observations; retain all receipts
    configure           Create explicit local pairing configuration
    pair                Explicitly pair a Desktop chat
    complete            Record a completed Herdr task's result
    abandon             Release a receipt after manual investigation; does NOT
                        cancel execution
    install             Legacy Herdr TUI and Codex connection installer
    herdr-app           Install the Herdr App side panel (the fleet column)
                        and the themes

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Bridge config file (resolves to
                        /home/user/.config/answerback/config.json on this
                        machine)
  --version             show program's version number and exit
